title: Ensembl genome metadata (legacy release + new metadata API)
maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

formats.description: REST GET /info/assembly/:species (legacy Ensembl release, rest.ensembl.org). Assembly-level keys of the response; the top_level_region array is split out as ensembl_rest_toplevel_region.
formats.record_key: assembly_accession (one response per species URL; the species is only in the URL)

formats.description: Rows of top_level_region inside the REST /info/assembly/:species response; one record per toplevel sequence of the primary assembly (no alt/patch scaffolds, no LRGs). synonyms present only with ?synonyms=1.

REST GET /info/assembly/:species/:region_name; facts about one toplevel sequence. The response does not repeat the region name or species; both are only in the request URL (the example file names carry them).
formats.record_key: none in the body; identified by the URL (species + region_name)

formats.description: REST GET /info/genomes/:genome_name (same object from /info/genomes/assembly/:accession). Built from the legacy ensembl_metadata database. Without expand=1; expand=1 adds large annotation/compara/variation blocks not covered here.

Core database meta table as dumped on the release FTP (mysql/<db>/meta.txt.gz): tab-separated meta_id, species_id, meta_key, meta_value, MySQL escaping, \N = NULL. The adapter returns one record per species_id; database-wide rows (species_id NULL: schema_type, schema_version, patch) are copied into each record; repeated keys become lists.
formats.record_key: species.production_name (plus database name, which is not inside the file)

formats.description: Per-release species list on the FTP root (release-116/species_EnsemblVertebrates.txt). Tab-separated with a '#name' header row; every data row ends with an extra tab.
formats.record_key: species (production name); core_db names the database

formats.description: Header lines of Ensembl genomic DNA FASTA files. Release FTP style: '>ID SEQTYPE:COORDSYS COORDSYS:VERSION:NAME:START:END:STRAND EXC' (EXC is 'REF' or empty with a trailing space). ensemblorganisms FTP style: '>ID SEQTYPE:COORDSYS VERSION:NAME:START:END:STRAND' (no coord system inside the location; non-reference scaffolds end with a trailing space). The format is positional; the field paths are names chosen here, following the Ensembl Slice name parts.

ensemblorganisms FTP <assembly path>/<provider>/<genebuild date>/genome/chromosomes.tsv.gz: two columns, sequence name and length, no header, sorted by length (longest first). Column names here are chosen; the file has none.

New Ensembl metadata API genome objects: /api/metadata/genome/{genome_id}/details, /explain (a subset of details), /api/search/genomes?query= (records = matches[]), and /api/metadata/genomeid?assembly_accession_id= (uses genome_uuid). Nested objects are flattened with '.'.
formats.record_key: genome_id (genome UUID); genome_tag is a readable alias (assembly accession)

formats.description: New Ensembl metadata API /api/metadata/genome/{genome_id}/karyotype; one record per karyotype region. /top-regions returns the same shape (identical for the two anchor genomes).
New Ensembl metadata API /api/metadata/genome/{genome_id}/stats; nested objects flattened with '.'. Only assembly_stats are about the sequences; the rest are annotation statistics.
formats.record_key: none in the body; identified by genome_id in the URL

formats.description: New Ensembl metadata API /api/metadata/genome/{genome_id}/ftplinks; one record per dataset directory on ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/ensemblorganisms.

ensemblorganisms FTP root species.json: catalog of every genome on the new FTP, keyed by species name then assembly accession. One record per species x assembly. '{species}' and '{accession}' in a path stand for those map keys; the field with the placeholder as its last part holds the key itself.

New Ensembl metadata API /api/metadata/genome/{genome_id}/checksum/{region_name}: a text/plain body holding one MD5 hex digest of the region sequence. No adapter: the body has no identifiers (genome and region are only in the URL). The example files collect the real responses for every karyotype region into one JSON object (region name -> body); that wrapper is ours, not Ensembl's.

Core database sequence tables (seq_region, coord_system, seq_region_synonym + external_db, seq_region_attrib + attrib_type). No adapter: a usable record needs a join across several MySQL dump files. The example files are a derived view we built by joining the real release-116 dumps (one row per toplevel seq_region, LRGs excluded); see README.md.

New Ensembl genome metadata database (ensembl_genome_metadata), defined by the SQLAlchemy models in Ensembl/ensembl-metadata-api. Tables genome, assembly, assembly_sequence, sequence_alias, organism. No adapter: no public dump of this database was found; the new metadata API exposes parts of it. Example values are taken from API responses that expose the same column, as noted per field; null where no public value was seen.

fields.description: Assembly name (GRCh38.p14, R64-1-1).
fields.notes: Production meta_key description: Must be less than 16 characters long for web display eg. http://www.ensembl.org/info/website/archives/assembly.html. Use official Assembly Name from assembly_report.txt if it's less than or equal to 16 characters. Otherwise a truncated form. Possibly used by Web on the species home page in the assembly table. Stored as text in meta_value.

fields.description: Long descriptive assembly name.

fields.description: How the gene annotation was made (full_genebuild, import, ...).
fields.notes: Gene annotation, not the assembly. Production meta_key description: Now: Only use full_genebuild and import Previously: full_genebuild,projection_build,import,mixed_stragegy_build. Full genebuild is use of standard annotation system. Projection build is use of projection pipeline from a reference (usually human) to either a low coverage or higher primate genome. Import used only for ensembl-genomes species. Mixed strategy covers other combinations for example a pr Stored as text in meta_value.

fields.description: MD5 hex digest of the region's sequence (the whole text/plain body).

fields.notes: Present for every toplevel sequence of both anchors.

fields.notes: Standard refget digest: for human MT we hashed the release-116 FASTA (uppercase sequence) and got the same MD5 and sha512t24u as the attributes.
